derivation: a primitive root (identical with H7819 (שָׁחַט) through the idea of striking);

occurrences.text: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of gold went to one target.
And he made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three pound of gold went to one shield: and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
